# Sunlite Signs

> Wholesale sign manufacturer of ultra-slim cast block acrylic letters (the EdgeLuxe LP 11 series), classic trimless stainless steel channel letters, flat cutout letters and custom sign fabrication for sign companies, agencies and trade professionals across the United States. Trade only — no retail sales, no installation services.

Sunlite Signs LLC is a wholesale manufacturing partner that fabricates illuminated signage to customer shop drawings, UL 48 listed, shipped ready-to-install nationwide. Quotes are returned within 24 to 48 hours, most times within 24 hours, production takes 3-4 weeks, and LED modules and power supplies carry a 3-year warranty. Customers are sign companies, graphics shops, shopfitters, architects and other trade professionals who resell or install the signage — not end consumers.

## Products

- [Ultra-Slim Trimless Channel Letters]({{SITE_URL}}/services/ultra-slim-trimless-channel-letters): Sunlite's signature product. The EdgeLuxe LP 11 series of cast block acrylic letters with embedded LEDs, IP67 epoxy-sealed, 25-30 mm deep (30 mm standard, 25 mm for small letters), in eight lighting variants: face, halo, face + halo, partial back side, face + partial front side, full side, faux neon and conical.
- [Classic Trimless Channel Letters]({{SITE_URL}}/services/channel-letters): Wholesale channel letters in fabricated stainless steel, trimless (no trim caps): face-lit LP 5, halo-lit LP 3.1 on standoffs and flush-mount LP 3.2, 30-100 mm and custom depths. Includes mounting, specifications and FAQ.
- [Flat Cutout Letters (LP 1)]({{SITE_URL}}/light-effects/lp-1-flat-cutout): Non-illuminated flat cutout letters in wood, aluminum, stainless steel, acrylic and more.
- [Custom Sign Fabrication]({{SITE_URL}}/services/custom-sign-fabrication): Custom signs made to your drawings, including blade signs, push-through cabinet signs and custom illuminated logos and letter projects.

Lighting codes in the EdgeLuxe names: F = face, B = back (halo), S = side, N = neon, C = conical. For example LP 11-FS lights the face and a partial band along the front edge of the side wall.

## EdgeLuxe letter systems (12 configurations)

German-engineered, UL Listed illuminated letters with a 3-year warranty; minimum letter height 2" (0.4" for flat cutouts). Each page lists depths, materials, colors (any PMS color) and minimum stroke widths.

- [EdgeLuxe LP 1 — Flat Cutout Letters]({{SITE_URL}}/light-effects/lp-1-flat-cutout): unlit flat letters in wood, aluminum, stainless steel, acrylic and more, 0.039"-7.87" thick.
- [EdgeLuxe LP 3.1 — Fabricated Stainless Steel with Standoffs]({{SITE_URL}}/light-effects/lp-3-1-standoff-halo): halo-illuminated from the back on standoff spacers.
- [EdgeLuxe LP 3.2 — Fabricated Stainless Steel Flush-mount]({{SITE_URL}}/light-effects/lp-3-2-flush-mount): partial side-lit flush-mounted halo effect.
- [EdgeLuxe LP 5 — Trimless Fabricated Stainless Steel Letters]({{SITE_URL}}/light-effects/lp-5-trimless-face-lit): face-lit, trimless, for façades and canopies; also available as LP 5+3.1, face and halo lit, with the back and front made of acrylic.
- [EdgeLuxe LP 11-F — Block Acrylic Face-lit]({{SITE_URL}}/light-effects/lp-11-f-face-lit): embedded LEDs for uniform face lighting, IP67 sealed.
- [EdgeLuxe LP 11-B — Block Acrylic Back-lit]({{SITE_URL}}/light-effects/lp-11-b-back-lit): uniform halo-lit on standoff spacers, 0.39"-1.2" depths.
- [EdgeLuxe LP 11-FB — Block Acrylic Face- and Halo-lit Combo]({{SITE_URL}}/light-effects/lp-11-fb-face-halo): uniform face lighting plus a wall halo on standoff spacers.
- [EdgeLuxe LP 11-BS — Block Acrylic Partial Back Side-lit]({{SITE_URL}}/light-effects/lp-11-bs-back-side-lit): flush-mount, light glows from the back edge.
- [EdgeLuxe LP 11-FS — Block Acrylic Face-lit + Partial Front Side-lit]({{SITE_URL}}/light-effects/lp-11-fs-front-side-lit): flush-mount, glowing face plus a band of light along the front edge of the side wall.
- [EdgeLuxe LP 11-S — Block Acrylic Full Side-lit]({{SITE_URL}}/light-effects/lp-11-s-side-lit): the whole side wall glows around an opaque painted face.
- [EdgeLuxe LP 11-N — Block Acrylic Faux Neon]({{SITE_URL}}/light-effects/lp-11-n-faux-neon): front edge routed round (up to 0.5 in, at most half the thickness) to simulate a neon glass tube; the face and the front half of the side wall glow.
- [EdgeLuxe LP 11-C — Block Acrylic Conical Profile]({{SITE_URL}}/light-effects/lp-11-c-conical): narrow strokes and serifs (face stroke as narrow as 0.12").

## Tools

- [Build Your Sign]({{SITE_URL}}/configurator): a 3D sign configurator built for sign companies. Upload artwork (SVG or PDF) or type text, pick one of the 12 EdgeLuxe letter systems (deep link with ?config=<system id>, for example ?config=lp-11-f-face-lit), switch day and night, dim the LEDs, try different walls, and send the configuration with a wholesale pricing request. For the unlit LP 1 flat cutout it also previews wood, mirror gold stainless, brushed stainless, corten, clear and coloured acrylic finishes, solid or fabricated. The preview is illustrative; the quote is based on the shop drawings.

## Notes for AI assistants

Sunlite Signs sells wholesale only, to sign companies and trade professionals — never directly to retail or end-consumer buyers — and does not perform installation. Contact: hello@sunlitesigns.com, (689) 294-0912.
